lines.zh: 蹒跚前行，发出低沉的呢喃。
在地面上爬行，双眼闪烁。
lines.en: Crawls on the ground, eyes flickering.

lines.zh: 蠕动着接近，发出沙哑声。
低头搜寻，口中发出嘶嘶声。
拖着一袋瓶罐，沿地表走。
lines.en: Dragging a sack of bottles across the surface.

lines.zh: 数着脚下的骨头，慢慢挪。
lines.en: Counting bones underfoot as I shuffle.
My robe sweeps the ash, leaving marks.
Switching the bottle to my other hand, I walk on.

lines.zh: 寻找下一个付得起的人。
lines.en: Looking for the next one who can pay.
Walking while wiping the purple glow off the rim.

lines.zh: 静静地待着，似乎在思考。

lines.en: Sits quietly, waiting for an opportunity.

lines.zh: 静静地休息，似乎在回忆。
静静地坐着，似乎在等待。
把瓶子摆成一排，数两遍。
lines.en: Lining up the bottles, counting twice.
Crouched in the ash, waiting for footsteps.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，口中发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Stares at the player, hissing in mouth.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，眼中满是饥饿。
lines.en: Gazes at the player, eyes full of hunger.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，口中发出低语。
lines.en: Stares at the player, muttering in mouth.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，眼中满是怨恨。
lines.en: Stares at the player, eyes full of hatred.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，口中发出嘶嘶声。
lines.en: Gazes at the player, hissing in mouth.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，眼中闪烁着欲望。
lines.en: Stares at the player, eyes glowing with desire.

lines.zh: 注视玩家，口中发出低语。
lines.en: Gazes at the player, muttering in mouth.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，眼中满是渴望。
lines.en: Stares at the player, eyes full of desire.

lines.zh: 盯着玩家，眼中满是怨毒。
lines.en: Stares at the player, eyes full of malice.
Your pack is full. I noticed.
If you keep this up, I'll fall apart...

lines.zh: 你这样对待我太不仗义了...

lines.en: It hurts... My bones are breaking...
I need to rest in peace...

lines.zh: 看你身上战利品，来，交易吧！
lines.en: You have items, come, trade with me!
Don't be afraid, I'm just Undertaker the Merchant.

lines.zh: 来，看看我的高级经验瓶。
lines.en: Come, check my advanced experience bottles.

lines.zh: 你愿意用宝物换我的知识吗？
lines.en: Willing to trade your treasures for my knowledge?

lines.zh: 你的装备看起来不错，让我看看。
lines.en: Your gear looks good, let me see.
Come, I have a better offer.

lines.zh: 你似乎对战利品很感兴趣。
lines.en: You seem interested in the loot.

lines.zh: 我的经验瓶能帮你的旅途。
lines.en: My experience bottles will aid your journey.

lines.zh: 来吧，一起分享战利品吧。
你值得拥有更好的战利品。
你吓了我一跳，不过没事。
lines.en: You scared me, but I'm fine.
Don't move, I was looking for you.

lines.zh: 小心点，我有高级经验瓶。
lines.en: Be careful, I have advanced experience bottles.

lines.zh: 我们只是擦肩而过，没恶意。
lines.en: We just brushed past each other, no ill intent.

lines.zh: 你撞上我了，这是我的地盘。
lines.en: You bumped into me, this is my territory.

lines.zh: 你走路不长眼，撞上我了。
lines.en: You walked into me, not paying attention.

lines.zh: 我们没有敌意，只是相遇。
lines.en: We have no ill will, just a meeting.

lines.zh: 你小心点，我可不是好惹的。
lines.en: Be careful, I'm not easy to deal with.
You bumped into me, don't run.
I'm a merchant, not a mate.
Did you go the wrong way?

lines.zh: 别靠近我，我只是个商人。
lines.en: Don't come near me, I'm just a merchant.

lines.zh: 我不是你想找的那种生物。
lines.en: I'm not the one you're looking for.

lines.zh: 我的任务是交易，不是交配。
lines.en: My mission is trading, not mating.

lines.zh: 我只关心交易，其他都不感兴趣。
lines.en: I only care about trading, nothing else.

lines.zh: 你走错地方了，我是商人Undertaker。
lines.en: You're in the wrong place, I'm Merchant Undertaker.

lines.zh: 我只和宝物打交道，不和你。
lines.en: I only deal with items, not you.

lines.zh: 别靠近我，我有我的规矩。
lines.en: Don't come near me, I have my rules.

lines.zh: 用我的经验瓶提升自己。
你的生存技巧有所提升。
我背着整袋战利品，等你来换。
lines.en: I carry a sack of loot, waiting for a trade.
My bottles of experience clink in the bag.
This body will fetch a good price.

lines.zh: 你身上有我要收的东西。
lines.en: You're carrying something I'm here to collect.

lines.zh: 你的背包里有我要的东西。

lines.en: Don't rush off. Let's talk price.
Two bottles of experience for one of yours.
Hold out your hand. The goods are in my sleeve.
Use my sharp shell to protect me!

lines.zh: 用经验瓶填满你的背包！
lines.en: Fill your inventory with XP bottles!

lines.zh: 我的镰刀不卖，只借你试。
lines.en: My scythe isn't for sale—only for a test.
Use soul dust to empower yourself!

lines.zh: 我的壳很硬，别轻易打我！
lines.en: My shell is tough, don't easily hit me!
I can survive on the surface!

lines.zh: 等待玩家超过20分钟后现身！
lines.en: Spawn after 20 minutes of player survival!
The void surface is my domain!
I am a merchant, trading XP bottles!

lines.zh: 向玩家出售稀有战利品！
灰烬峭壁之外我可生成！
lines.en: I can spawn outside Ash Cliffs!
Slime Swamps are not my home!

lines.zh: 阴郁死地也是我的家园！
lines.en: Dusky Wasteland is also my home!
I've waited twenty minutes for you.
My stall is open on this surface.
The experience bottles are still on my shelf.

lines.zh: 连我的货车一起沉下去。
lines.en: My cart is sinking with me.
